# Third-party assets

## Fluent Emoji — Microsoft

Used only for the launcher icon. `mipmap-*/ic_launcher_foreground.png` and the monochrome layer are
the "Waving hand" emoji, composited over a gradient generated in this repository. The gradient and
the icon layout are original; the hand is Microsoft's.

- Source: https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-emoji
- Licence: MIT, full text in `fluent-emoji-LICENSE.txt`

## Bubble characters — original

The six faces in `app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/face_*.png` are one character in six poses,
generated for this project by its author. They are not derived from any existing commercial
character, which was the point: the earlier attempt used art from a commercial sticker set, and
shipping that in a public repository would have been infringement no matter how good it looked.
